decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the indirect platform lift is used.

Condition : 3 - The indirect platform lift hereby permitted shall be retained for a limited period only until 31/7/2005, on or before which date the chairlift shall be removed, and the building restored to its former condition.
description: Formation of access for disabled persons to Engine House Museum by use of indirect platforms lift for wheelchair plus additional seat installed on external staircase to main entrance.
